title: 句子骨架
subtitle: 搭基本车架
outcome: 认出谓语、宾语、补语；无双谓语/残句。

title: 名词系统
subtitle: 装入人/事物/概念
fingerprint:
Det+(Adj)+N+(后置修饰)
a/an/the/零冠词+N｜one/many/much+N
S(sg/pl)+V(sg/pl)｜one of+Ns+V(sg)
outcome: 冠词、数、一致和指代稳定；名词不「裸奔」。

title: 时态系统
subtitle: 设定时间与视角
fingerprint:
S+[aux]+V：do / be doing / have done / have been doing
过去｜现在｜将来｜过去将来
By+参照点, S+will/would have done
outcome: 先定时间线，再选事实/过程/结果/持续。

title: 动词链
subtitle: 控制立场与焦点
fingerprint:
S+modal+(have)+V｜S+be+V-ed
S+V+to do/doing｜S+V+O+to do
make/let+O+do｜have/get+O+V-ed｜wish+过去式
outcome: 控制情态、被动、非谓语、使役、愿望与转述。

title: 并列与逻辑
subtitle: 连接平行观点
fingerprint:
Clause+and/but/so+Clause
Clause because Clause｜Because of+N, Clause
Although+Clause, Clause｜Despite+N, Clause
outcome: 连接单位匹配；无逗号粘连；形成观点链。

title: 状语与条件
subtitle: 安装背景条件
fingerprint:
When/Because/Although+Clause, Clause
If+现在, will+V｜If+过去, would+V
If+had done, would have done｜so that+Clause
outcome: 控制时间、原因、让步、目的及真实/虚拟条件。

title: 从句插槽
subtitle: 扩展名词或观点
fingerprint:
N+who/which/that+V...
That/What/Whether+Clause+V｜V+that/wh-+Clause
Could you tell me+wh-+S+V...?（间接疑问）
outcome: 看出从句修饰谁/占何成分；能主动造复杂句。

title: 句子压缩
subtitle: 精简次要结构
fingerprint:
N+V-ing/V-ed...｜To do..., S+V
Doing/Done..., S+V｜Having done..., S+V
Clause → participle phrase｜S+be+V-ed
outcome: 压缩后主干仍清楚；动作执行者不悬垂。

title: 高阶表达
subtitle: 调校语气与焦点
fingerprint:
A+be+more...than+B｜twice as...as
It may be argued that+Clause｜What...is...
Not only+Aux+S+V...｜N, apposition, ...
outcome: 控制比较、hedging、名词化、强调、倒装与语域。

title: 整车上路
subtitle: 综合真实输出
fingerprint:
简单骨架 → 从句扩展 → 非谓语压缩 → 语气校准
写作：claim+reason+example+result
口语：answer+reason+detail+reflection
outcome: 跨主题调用；150词重大错≤4；总评≥81/100。
